header: The cost of survey points nobody maintains
lead: Every district has fixed survey points that everyone uses and nobody owns. Ulrike Traxler has spent six years measuring what it costs when they drift, with figures from three districts.
author: Ulrike Traxler
role: Professor of surveying, Technische Hochschule Sandau

image.alternative: Portrait of Ulrike Traxler, a woman in her sixties with grey hair pinned up and a patterned scarf.
